newsitem.title: UK: Caradon finishes sale of non-core Euro units.
newsitem.headline: Caradon finishes sale of non-core Euro units.

text.p: British manufacturer Caradon Plc said on Wednesday it had sold the rest of its European engineering and distribution businesses to Vector Industries Ltd for about 200 million stg.
Vector is a holding company backed by UK venture capital company CINVen.
"This disposal, together with the sale of our automotive plastics businesses, completes our programme of divesting our non-core businesses in Europe," Caradon said in a statement.
Caradon said in August it planned to sell the businesses.
